verses.text: Remember, O LORD, what has befallen us; Look, and see our reproach!
verses.textZh: 耶和華啊，求你記念我們所遭遇的事，觀看我們所受的凌辱。

verses.text: Our inheritance has been turned over to strangers, Our houses to aliens.
verses.textZh: 我們的產業歸與外邦人；我們的房屋歸與外路人。

verses.text: We have become orphans without a father, Our mothers are like widows.
verses.textZh: 我們是無父的孤兒；我們的母親好像寡婦。

verses.text: We have to pay for our drinking water, Our wood comes [to us] at a price.
verses.textZh: 我們出錢才得水喝；我們的柴是人賣給我們的。

verses.text: Our pursuers are at our necks; We are worn out, there is no rest for us.
verses.textZh: 追趕我們的，到了我們的頸項上；我們疲乏不得歇息。

verses.text: We have submitted to Egypt [and] Assyria to get enough bread.
verses.textZh: 我們投降埃及人和亞述人，為要得糧吃飽。

verses.text: Our fathers sinned, [and] are no more; It is we who have borne their iniquities.
verses.textZh: 我們列祖犯罪，而今不在了；我們擔當他們的罪孽。

verses.text: Slaves rule over us; There is no one to deliver us from their hand.
verses.textZh: 奴僕轄制我們，無人救我們脫離他們的手。

verses.text: We get our bread at the risk of our lives Because of the sword in the wilderness.
verses.textZh: 因為曠野的刀劍，我們冒著險才得糧食。

verses.text: Our skin has become as hot as an oven, Because of the burning heat of famine.
verses.textZh: 因飢餓燥熱，我們的皮膚就黑如爐。

verses.text: They ravished the women in Zion, The virgins in the cities of Judah.
verses.textZh: 敵人在錫安玷污婦人，在猶大的城邑玷污處女。

verses.text: Princes were hung by their hands; Elders were not respected.
verses.textZh: 他們吊起首領的手，也不尊敬老人的面。

verses.text: Young men worked at the grinding mill, And youths stumbled under [loads] of wood.
verses.textZh: 少年人扛磨石，孩童背木柴，都絆跌了。

verses.text: Elders are gone from the gate, Young men from their music.
verses.textZh: 老年人在城門口斷絕；少年人不再作樂。

verses.text: The joy of our hearts has ceased; Our dancing has been turned into mourning.
verses.textZh: 我們心中的快樂止息，跳舞變為悲哀。

verses.text: The crown has fallen from our head; Woe to us, for we have sinned!
verses.textZh: 冠冕從我們的頭上落下；我們犯罪了，我們有禍了！

verses.text: Because of this our heart is faint, Because of these things our eyes are dim;
verses.textZh: 這些事我們心裡發昏，我們的眼睛昏花。

verses.text: Because of Mount Zion which lies desolate, Foxes prowl in it.
verses.textZh: 錫安山荒涼，野狗（或譯：狐狸）行在其上。

verses.text: You, O LORD, rule forever; Your throne is from generation to generation.
verses.textZh: 耶和華啊，你存到永遠；你的寶座存到萬代。

verses.text: Why do You forget us forever? Why do You forsake us so long?
verses.textZh: 你為何永遠忘記我們？為何許久離棄我們？

verses.text: Restore us to You, O LORD, that we may be restored; Renew our days as of old,
verses.textZh: 耶和華啊，求你使我們向你回轉，我們便得回轉。求你復新我們的日子，像古時一樣。

verses.text: Unless You have utterly rejected us [And] are exceedingly angry with us.
verses.textZh: 你竟全然棄絕我們，向我們大發烈怒？
